responsibility: Implements GCC’s internal software floating-point arithmetic and format semantics for REAL_VALUE_TYPE. It owns the core representation-independent operations on real constants—construction, normalization, arithmetic, comparison, rounding, parsing/printing helpers, nextafter, integer conversion, format truncation, representability queries, and predicates such as HONOR_NANS/HONOR_INFINITIES/HONOR_SIGNED_ZEROS—serving as the fundamental engine behind constant folding and floating-point range reasoning.
same_name_distinction: Contains the core implementation of GCC’s internal REAL_VALUE_TYPE arithmetic, normalization, comparison, rounding, formatting, and format-property logic; unlike gcc/real.h it is not the type/interface definition, and unlike gcc/realmpfr.cc it is the main floating-point engine rather than the MPFR bridge.
